description: This file defines classes for mapping streams to queues using a hash ring, including a consistent ring stream queue mapper and a partitioned stream queue mapper, within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: HashRingBasedStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Implements a stream queue mapper that uses a hash ring to assign queues based on consistent hashing, balancing load across silos.

classes.name: HashRingBasedPartitionedStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Extends the hash ring mapper to associate specific partitions with QueueIds, enabling partition-aware queue mapping.

methods.name: GetQueuesForRange
methods.description: Returns all QueueIds within a specified ring range.

methods.name: GetAllQueues
methods.description: Returns all QueueIds managed by the hash ring.

methods.name: GetQueueForStream
methods.description: Determines the responsible QueueId for a given stream based on its hash code.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the hash ring.

methods.name: QueueToPartition
methods.description: Maps a QueueId back to its associated partition identifier.
